Interface MemoryStateController

All Known Implementing Classes:
RouxEngine
public interface MemoryStateController
The MemoryStateController is the call set that appends messages and takes locks. appendMessage(String, byte, long, int, String) stores one message frame. clearRegion(String) drops the frames and keeps the region. tryAcquireLock(String, int, long) takes the region lock for an operator. releaseLock(LockToken) drops that operator lock. An append also takes the same region lock. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#MemoryStateController roux-design.md

  • Method Details

    • appendMessage

      OperationResult appendMessage(String regionId, byte role, long timestampEpochMs, int tokenCount, String text)
      The method stores one message frame. The payload is the text encoding written by ToonCodec. The frame type is FrameType.MSG.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the name of the region.
      role - The role is a byte from Role.
      timestampEpochMs - The time is the epoch milliseconds stored with the message.
      tokenCount - The token count is the number stored with the message.
      text - The text is the message body.
      Returns:
      The result is an OperationResult.

    • clearRegion

      void clearRegion(String regionId)
      The method drops the frames and keeps the region. The region then has a new empty hot page.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the name of the region.

    • tryAcquireLock

      LockToken tryAcquireLock(String regionId, int level, long timeoutMs)
      The method tries to take the region lock. The wait stops when the timeout elapses.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the name of the region.
      level - The level is a code from LockLevel.
      timeoutMs - The timeout is the maximum wait in milliseconds.
      Returns:
      The token is the lock handle, or null when the lock was not taken.

    • releaseLock

      boolean releaseLock(LockToken token)
      The method releases an operator lock.
      Parameters:
      token - The token is the handle from tryAcquireLock(String, int, long).
      Returns:
      The flag is true when this token was the lock that was held.
